gold: Drug-induced dermatomyositis secondary to ipilimumab therapy

selector.rationale: Skin symptoms and specific dermatomyositis findings such as photodistributed erythematous eruption, diffuse erythema, and prominent erythema at nailfolds support this diagnosis, despite the lack of inflammatory myositis on biopsy

rejected.label: Melanoma-associated Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Lack of specific melanoma-associated findings beyond the patient's known melanoma diagnosis

rejected.label: Polymyositis
rejected.why: Absence of specific polymyositis findings and presence of dermatomyositis-specific skin symptoms

rejected.label: Overlap Myositis
rejected.why: Negative Jo-1 antibody and lack of clear overlap with another connective tissue disease
